rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax printed '1.85%' in 'שיעור הריבית המוצעת (נומינלי)', the same in 'שיעור הריבית לפיקדון שכיח'. Row 'פיקדון לשנתיים', rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'צמוד', 'סכום מינימלי להפקדה' '1,000 ₪', 'סכום מקסימלי להפקדה' 'ללא הגבלה', break 'לא קיימת', 'במידה וקיימת - פירוט מנגנון הקנס' '-', automatic renewal 'לא קיימת', number of renewals '0', exit points 'לא קיימת' '-'. This row as printed: '1,000 ₪' to 'ללא הגבלה': '1.85%'. Read 2026-11-09 from the bank's PDF of its standard table ('בתוקף החל מה-20.10.2026'; the file the library holds as 75134f72b85da5de, fetched again today, Last-Modified 21 Oct 2026). The site pages that link the table answer with a Radware captcha, so whether a newer table has replaced it could not be checked. The common-deposit column repeats the offered rate on every row; the row 'פיקדון יומי' prints '-' in every column.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ב); עמ' 41, סעיף 9(13)

tax_bucket.notes: Read as fully linked to the consumer price index on the 447 table's linkage column alone (quoted in the notes of rate_offered); no terms document of this deposit was read for its linkage, so whether the linkage is full, which the bucket needs (TXI-04: a deposit counts as linked only when fully linked to the index), rests on that column. Fully linked: the linkage differentials are exempt (TXI-05) and the interest above the linkage is taxed at up to 25% (TXI-02), at a lower bracket from age 60 (TXI-19). Copied from the rule base (sources read there 2026-10-25), not re-read today. The engine reads no tax_bucket today.
